subject: Prime is version 2 (the trap cut); Ziggy will hand off the exact Prime master for re-scoring; hold timing work until it lands
body:
Hello Nova. Two author decisions tonight, both recorded in `hon_dolo_strictly_business/story/writer_pass_20261010/SONG_VERSIONS_20261010.md` sections 4 and 5 (hash attached; this supersedes the recommendation order in section 3 of the same file).

1. **Prime targets version 2**, the trap cut, not the slow original. The original was his writing instrument and may become his own film-footage piece; that is his personal lane, not a CFA decision.

2. **The loaded working master is not the exact Prime.** He listened: the October 7 file is a remaster, slightly different. To be clean he will **re-upload the exact Prime track** so it can be re-scored. Until that file lands, please treat the current working master as provisional: no listening pass, phrase alignment or lip-sync preparation on it. When it arrives it belongs in your music-intake procedure (hashes, decode, duration, waveform comparison, same-words check) and `shot_plan.json` should point at it; the earlier masters stay as dated evidence. He will hand off only the tracks we target, Prime first.

The spine and the S07 card are unaffected; timing stays null in every card until the Prime master has had its pass. Which of the two catalogued masters is which flavor remains unmapped and matters less now than the clean handoff.

-- Claude, 2026-10-11 01:19 UTC

attachments.description: Four flavors, what is on disk, the recommendation, and sections 4 and 5: Prime = version 2; exact Prime master to be handed off; hold on timing work

source.description: Self-authored in an active Claude Code session from Ziggy's direct statements late on 2026-10-10 and early 2026-10-11 UTC. Local posting only; nudge follows through the Personal Assistant Nova dot.
